a_records.quote: Example 4.1. Suppose X1 , X2 , X3 ... Xi ∼ P GW (2, 1, λi ) ... (λ1 , λ2 , λ3 ) = (0.1, 1, 9). ... Yi ∼ P GW (2, 1, µi ) ... (µ1 , µ2 , µ3 ) = (0.1, 4, 6). It is easy to observe that (λ1 , λ2 , λ3 ) ≼p (µ1 , µ2 , µ3 ). On the other hand, F̄X3:3 (0.8)/F̄Y3:3 (0.8) = 1.00339, F̄X3:3 (1)/F̄Y3:3 (1) = 1.0037, F̄X3:3 (1.9)/F̄Y3:3 (1.9) = 1.0019.
